# Mark Adler's blast

`blast.c` and `blast.h` are unmodified copies of zlib's `contrib/blast` at tag
`v1.3.1`:

<https://github.com/madler/zlib/tree/v1.3.1/contrib/blast>

The files implement PKWARE Data Compression Library decompression and are
compiled explicitly by this project; they are not supplied by an installed
zlib library. The original zlib license notice is retained in `blast.h`.
